name: agentdyno-vscode
description: Thin wrapper: opens the AgentDyno local dashboard (scan/fit/switch/doctor/connect) inside VS Code. Requires the AgentDyno CLI (github.com/sauravGit/agentdyno) checked out on disk — this extension does not bundle it.

chatParticipants.name: agentdyno
chatParticipants.description: Local model status, the doctor exam, and Goose/Cline connect configs — talks to your local `dyno dashboard`.

commands.name: connect
commands.description: Get a Goose or Cline connect config: /connect goose or /connect cline

disambiguation.description: Questions about the locally running AgentDyno model server, its verified grade, or connecting Goose/Cline to it.
examples: Is my local model server running?
What grade did doctor give this model?
Get me the Goose connect config

commands.title: AgentDyno: Connect Cline (copy settings + open Cline's panel)

agentdyno.repoPath.description: Absolute path to a local clone of github.com/sauravGit/agentdyno (the directory containing dist/src/cli.js after `npm run build`). Leave empty and you'll be prompted the first time.

agentdyno.dashboardUrl.description: AgentDyno dashboard URL. Only change this if you started `dyno dashboard` on a non-default port.
